name: flower-trellis
description: 一键安装/升级 Trellis 并自动融合 skill-garden 强化包(默认 Claude + agents)

scripts.test: node --test test/js/*.test.js && python3 -m unittest discover -s test/python -p 'test_*.py' && node scripts/check-patch-conflicts.mjs && npm run patch:targets:check && node scripts/check-ai-context-budget.mjs && node scripts/check-output-templates.mjs
